Authored fixtures for the Political `lobbying` feature (#1911). Every file is
written by hand in the documented shape of its register (EU Transparency
Register XML export, Lobbyregister JSON, EP meetings CSV, Commission meetings
JSON, UK Register of Consultant Lobbyists CSV). All organisations, people,
identifiers, procedure references and printed-paper numbers are fictional and
use the reserved year 2099 or the `example`/`fictional` naming; nothing here is
live evidence.
